Name: Plato Warp Menu
Author: Platonymous
Description:
[center][heading]Plato Warp Menu[/heading] by Platonymous[/center][line]
[b]Visual Warp Menu[/b] that allows you to pick a location and warp to any spot by clicking on it.[center]

[img]https://imgur.com/T5Eybda.png[/img]

Open the Warp Menu with [b]J[/b] key (key can be changed in the config.json file after the first run).
Pick a location directly or have it show the location of a character or artifact spot.
Click on the map-image to pick a spot[s] and warp there.[/s]

After picking a sport, click on the "Warp To ..." text to perform the warp.

The locations in the menu are populated from all available locations during a game,
even modded and/or otherwiese unreachable locations are accessible.

If the images of the locations don't show up for you change "UseTempFolder" in the config.json file (or the GMCM menu) to true.
If you are having issues you can also set "CompatibilityMode" to true



[img]https://imgur.com/b8d5H2A.png[/img]﻿
If you have any questions you can usually find me on the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Community#Discord]Stardew Valley Discord[/url]﻿ under the username [b]Routine[/b]#8715
